name: Unidentified Wookiee medical droid
description: Members of the Wookiee species built a medical droid on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 BBY and 36 BBY for the purpose of saving Attichitcuk, a Wookiee Chieftain who had been shot and gravely injured by B1-series battle droids of the Trade Federation. The medical droid traveled to Attichitcuk's location along with a party of Wookiees led by his son, Chewbacca, where the droid was able to give enough medical aid to save the Chieftain's life.

data.name: Unidentified Wookiee medical droid
data.birth: Between 39 BBY and 36 BBY, Alaris Prime
